tasks.subject: Task 0: Capture real event fixtures
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Produce real motion, smartDetectZone, ring and end-frame payloads from the live console, so every downstream test is built on observed data rather than the spec.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/capture-events.mjs`
- Create: `test/fixtures/events/{motion,smart-detect,ring,end-frames}.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] capture script connects to both subscriptions and writes frames with timestamps
- [ ] fixtures contain a real motion event, a smartDetectZone event with non-empty smartDetectTypes, and a ring event
- [ ] fixtures contain an update frame with a non-null end for a previously-seen eventId
- [ ] redaction is consistent so event.device still matches the camera ids in the existing fixtures
- [ ] no API key, real MAC or stream token in any fixture

**Verify:** node scripts/capture-events.mjs --seconds 120 produces frames; grep for secrets finds nothing

Full step-by-step code is in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-camera-sensors.md`.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure event router
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A synchronous, HomeKit-free function turning an event frame into the sensor subtypes it drives and its phase.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/accessories/router.ts`
- Test: `test/router.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] routeEvent returns null for unhandled input and never throws
- [ ] motion maps to the motion subtype
- [ ] all three smart-detect channels map to detect-<type> subtypes
- [ ] smartAudioDetect maps only alrmSmoke and alrmCmonx
- [ ] ring maps to subtype ring with stateless true
- [ ] phase distinguishes start, end and momentary
- [ ] an unknown detection type is ignored not thrown

**Verify:** npx vitest run test/router.test.ts -> all passing

Full step-by-step code is in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-camera-sensors.md`.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Active-event tracker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reference-counted sensor state with failsafe timers, so overlapping events cannot clear a sensor early and a lost end-frame cannot strand one on forever.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/accessories/tracker.ts`
- Test: `test/tracker.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] overlapping events keep a subtype active until both end
- [ ] start reports a transition only on 0 to 1 holders
- [ ] end reports a transition only on the drop to 0 holders
- [ ] momentary returns an on-then-off pair
- [ ] a stateless ring returns one active true and stores nothing
- [ ] a failsafe timer clears an event whose end never arrives
- [ ] clearAll deactivates everything and returns the transitions
- [ ] stop cancels every timer
- [ ] a duplicate start does not double-count

**Verify:** npx vitest run test/tracker.test.ts -> all passing

Full step-by-step code is in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-camera-sensors.md`.

```json:metadata
{"files":[],"verifyCommand":"npx vitest run test/tracker.test.ts -> all passing","acceptanceCriteria":["overlapping events keep a subtype active until both end","start reports a transition only on 0 to 1 holders","end reports a transition only on the drop to 0 holders","momentary returns an on-then-off pair","a stateless ring returns one active true and stores nothing","a failsafe timer clears an event whose end never arrives","clearAll deactivates everything and returns the transitions","stop cancels every timer","a duplicate start does not double-count"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Camera service builder
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create, diff and remove HAP services on a camera accessory, and apply sensor changes to them.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/accessories/camera.ts`
- Test: `test/camera.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] camera gets AccessoryInformation, a motion sensor, and one sensor per enabled smart-detect type
- [ ] a supported-but-disabled type produces no sensor
- [ ] alrmSmoke and alrmCmonx produce Smoke and CO sensors only when enabled
- [ ] a camera with hasSpeaker gets a Doorbell service
- [ ] re-running the builder is idempotent
- [ ] disabling a type removes exactly that service
- [ ] applyChange sets the right characteristic and ignores unknown subtypes

**Verify:** npx vitest run test/camera.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit

Full step-by-step code is in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-camera-sensors.md`.

tasks.description:

- Test: `test/platform.test.ts` (extend)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
